title: 第14章 七日修行第15章 怀来之死
content_zh:
鄂珑走后，丹房外，传来怀来急促的脚步声。
“徐长生！徐长生你没事吧？”
怀来、李福等人推门而入。
看到徐长生苍白的脸色，还有染血的衣衫，所有人瞬间脸色大变。
“你怎么了？”
“没事。”
徐长生摇摇头，勉强笑了笑，“挨了一掌，还能撑住。”
怀来看着他，眼中满是复杂。
“我早说了，让我去......”
“换做是你，恐怕你就死了。”徐长生心有余悸。
刚刚炼丹确实凶险，只差一步，就是一炉废丹。
如果是废丹，谁来谁死！
也幸亏他有丹心，能感知到丹炉内的药性，及时提醒了鄂珑。
否则，他已经是一具冷冰冰的尸体。
怀来沉默良久，重重叹了口气。
“从今天起，你是我怀来的兄弟。在这丹院里，有什么事，跟我说。”
徐长生看着他，心中涌起一股暖意。
在这冰冷的修仙界，能遇到一个真心待你的人，太难得了。
“好。”徐长生重重点了点头。
李福拍了拍徐长生的肩膀，塞给他一颗疗伤丹，“给你七天假期，好好修养修养。”

“多谢李班头。”
…………
屋内。
“噗”
徐长生张口喷出一口黑血，血中夹杂着细碎的冰碴。
体内的寒毒终于被逼出，骨骼也在极品疗伤丹的药力下，缓缓复位。
只凭李福给的下品疗伤丹，七天时间根本不够用。
还是这极品丹药，药效来的更快。
“鄂珑，陆寒......你们这些高高在上的修士，早晚有一天，我要让你们知道，蝼蚁也能噬象！”
徐长生握紧拳头，指节因为用力而发白。
他低头看着小青葫，目光渐渐变得坚定。
“小青葫，你是我唯一的依仗。”
“我要变强，强到谁也不敢再欺辱我。”
“强到......这天地间，再无人能踩在我的头上！”
content_en:
After E Long left, Huai Lai's hurried footsteps could be heard outside the alchemy room.
"Xu Changsheng! Xu Changsheng, are you okay?"
Huailai, Li Fu and others pushed open the door and entered.
Seeing Xu Changsheng's pale face and blood-stained clothes, everyone's expressions suddenly changed.
"What's wrong with you?"
"It's okay."
Xu Changsheng shook his head and forced a smile, "I was slapped, but I can still hold on."
Huailai looked at him with complicated eyes.
"I told you earlier, let me go..."
"If it were you, I'm afraid you would die." Xu Changsheng was still frightened.
The elixir refining just now was indeed dangerous, and there was only one step left before it would be a useless elixir.
If it's a waste elixir, whoever comes will die!
Fortunately, he had an alchemy heart and could sense the medicinal properties in the alchemy furnace, so he alerted Elon in time.
Otherwise, he is already a cold corpse.
Huailai was silent for a long time and sighed heavily.
"From today on, you are my conceived brother. If anything happens in this alchemy courtyard, tell me."
Xu Changsheng looked at him, feeling warm in his heart.
In this cold world of immortality, it is so rare to meet someone who treats you sincerely.
"Okay." Xu Changsheng nodded heavily.
Li Fu patted Xu Changsheng's shoulder and gave him a healing pill, "I'll give you seven days of leave to cultivate yourself."
"Thank you, Captain Li."
…………
inside the house.
"Poof"
Xu Changsheng opened his mouth and spat out a mouthful of black blood, which was mixed with fine pieces of ice.
The cold poison in the body was finally forced out, and the bones slowly reset under the power of the best healing pill.
Just relying on the low-grade healing pills given by Li Fu, seven days was simply not enough.
This is the best elixir, and the effect comes faster.
"Elong, Lu Han... You high-minded monks, sooner or later, I will let you know that ants can also eat elephants!"
Xu Changsheng clenched his fists, his knuckles turning white from the exertion.
He looked down at Xiao Qinghu, his eyes gradually becoming firm.
"Xiao Qinghu, you are my only support."
"I want to become stronger, so strong that no one dares to bully me anymore."
"So strong...that no one in this world can step on my head!"
